description: Implementation of QuicDatagramQueue class managing datagram queuing and sending in QUIC protocol.

classes.name: QuicDatagramQueue
classes.description: Manages a queue of datagrams for QUIC sessions, handling sending, queuing, and expiration.

methods.name: SendOrQueueDatagram
methods.description: Attempts to send a datagram immediately or queues it if sending is blocked.

methods.name: TrySendingNextDatagram
methods.description: Attempts to send the next datagram in the queue if available.

methods.name: SendDatagrams
methods.description: Sends as many datagrams as possible from the queue.

methods.name: GetMaxTimeInQueue
methods.description: Calculates maximum allowed time a datagram can stay in the queue.

methods.name: RemoveExpiredDatagrams
methods.description: Removes datagrams that have expired from the queue.
